selection_basis.selection_rule: highest OOF balanced accuracy, then ROC-AUC, under approximately 10% binary false-acceptance rate

audit_observation.note: The SQI branch scored better on this audit set, but switching to it after viewing test results would be test-informed model selection.

deployment_scope: hackathon prototype and non-diagnostic measurement-quality support only
